entries.partTitle: Anatomy of a GPU Workgroup: Grid, Workgroups, Invocations & Builtin Variables

spec.title: System Architecture: Anatomy of a GPU Workgroup: Grid, Workgroups, Invocations & Builtin Variables

right.label: Modern WebGPU Compute Pipeline
content: Zero-copy on-chip storage and shared memory

steps.caption: Structural overview illustrates memory hierarchy levels, from on-chip workgroup shared memory down to external storage buffers.
Detailed inspection traces workgroup barrier synchronization fences and shared memory access patterns across active hardware execution lanes.
Comparative analysis measures bank conflict serialization stalls against stride-padded frictionless parallel streaming memory access.
Rigorous verification confirms race-free execution, zero thread deadlock hazards, and logarithmic parallel reduction tree convergence.
